  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · have h : runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program
        (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()))).isSome = true := by decide
    exact Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp h
  · have h : runLaunch unitOps layout geometry fuel program
        (initial layout (fun _ _ => ()) (fun _ => some ()))).isSome = true := by decide
    obtain ⟨final, hf⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp h
    subst hf
    decide", "segment_equivalence": "by
  intro input outside
  refine ⟨finalState ops input outside, ?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · have h : runLaunch ops layout geometry fuel program
        (initial layout input outside)).isSome = true := by
      unfold runLaunch layout geometry fuel program initial
      simp [geometry]
      rfl
    exact Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp h
  · have h : runLaunch ops layout geometry fuel program
        (initial layout input outside)).isSome = true := by
      unfold runLaunch layout geometry fuel program initial
      simp [geometry]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨final, hf⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp h
    subst hf
    unfold raceFree conflict ordered sameLocation
    decide
  ·
    have h : runLaunch ops layout geometry fuel program
        (initial layout input outside)).isSome = true := by
      unfold runLaunch layout geometry fuel program initial
      simp [geometry]
      rfl
    obtain ⟨final, hf⟩ := Option.isSome_iff_exists.mp h
    subst hf
    unfold extract layout finalState
    simp [layout]
    rfl"}}
